newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: RICHEMONT WANTS TO RAISE TV EXPOSURE.
newsitem.headline: RICHEMONT WANTS TO RAISE TV EXPOSURE.

text.p: The chief executive of Swiss-based Cie Financiere Richemont AG , Johann Rupert, said he would like to boost the company's involvement in the television industry.
"If allowed to, we would like to increase our financial exposure (in the televison sector)," he told reporters after the group's annual shareholder meeting.
"We'll take one problem at a time," he added.
"In two to three years, I expect strong earnings growth in pay TV," he said.
Rupert said he did not foresee any problem with EU cartel authorities over Canal Plus . "We are cautiously optimistic there should not be a stumbling block there," he said.
In a deal announced last Friday, Canal Plus will buy 100 percent of pay-television group Nethold from Richemont and MIH Holdings Ltd for $45 million cash and 6.1 million new Canal Plus shares.
Rupert declined to make a specific profit forecast for Richemont for the 1996/97 fiscal year ending on March 31.
He said only he was "cautiously optimistic" and that business was developing "in line with expectations."
